name: FLARE capa explorer
description: Binary Ninja plugin for exploring Capa Program Analysis results
longdescription: capa explorer brings capa's Program Analysis workflow into the Binary Ninja sidebar. It runs capa against the current Binary Ninja database, displays rule matches in an interactive tree, supports address navigation and highlighting, and can reopen cached results stored in the database.
